introduction: Explore the Keep of Evil’s prison,garrison and palace. Meet the aged librarian and prepare his desk-key commission while following leads about captives,the bound dragon,the court and its haunted past.
orientation: Enter through the current Surface gate and learn an admitted route back. The keep’s guarded wings and magical passages need preparation.
Seek the aged librarian in the library. He exchanges the exact golden desk key for experience; the ordinary golden,sapphire,tarnished and jailor keys have different uses.
Carry the desk key loose in your inventory. A recovered or supplied copy fits without your own flesh-eater victory,prison rescue,palace route or royal audience.
Flesh eaters in the palace are associated with desk-key sources. Finding a source,holding the key and recording the librarian’s accepted exchange are separate milestones.
A rusty switch responds to pushing. Clearing its blocked passage leaves a door to open; finding the switch and successfully passing the door are separate steps.
Touching the ruined monument offers another magical passage when it can actually be used. Its finite charges and your successful arrival are separate from the librarian’s exchange.
Prisoners,court captives and the bound red dragon suggest stories about helping living people and creatures. The journal does not yet record agreed rescues or safe destinations for them.
The stables and hungry dogs offer leads about living care. Ordinary combat,food possession or a following animal does not itself complete a care task.
The battle master’s advice and the alchemist’s stock offer leads about useful training and supplies. Advice,viewing stock and a successfully settled service are different milestones.
The armourer’s workshop refuses outsiders. The journal does not yet record a craft or repair commission there.
The keep’s holy Slayer,haunted corridors and wall suggest a history and restitution tale. Reading scenery or fighting a spirit does not itself complete peaceful release.
Aleena’s instruments and the court’s dignitaries suggest music and diplomatic stories. A useful performance or alliance needs its own agreed outcome.
A memory of the Keep of Evil has an existing exchange with an ambassador elsewhere. Recovering it here and completing that foreign commission are separate milestones.
The Knight of Fate and the eyes suggest a larger tale. The journal does not yet record an ordered eyes puzzle or a completed equipment restoration task.
The rune stone has its own epic reward rules. The librarian’s accepted exchange stays recorded after the key is spent;library restoration and epic awards remain separate outcomes.

stories.title: The aged librarian’s desk key
stories.summary: Return the exact golden desk key to the aged librarian for experience. A recovered or supplied copy fits without personal palace,prison or source history. Any library restoration remains a separate story.

steps.hint: Bring one exact desk key loose in your inventory. A recovered or supplied copy fits;other door keys do not satisfy this request.
The accepted desk-key exchange stays recorded after the key is spent. Library restoration and other useful tasks need their own outcomes.
